question_en: Is the stiffness in both hands, and are the joints swollen or warm?
question_hi: क्या दोनों हाथों में अकड़न है, और जोड़ सूजे या गर्म हैं?
question_hinglish: Kya dono hands me stiffness hai, aur joints swollen ya warm hain?

transcript: kandhe me dard hai haath upar nahi uthta
question_en: Did this follow an injury, and can you move the shoulder at all or is there numbness?
question_hi: क्या यह चोट के बाद हुआ, और क्या कंधा थोड़ा भी हिला सकते हैं या सुन्नपन है?
question_hinglish: Injury ke baad hua, aur shoulder thoda move hota hai ya numbness hai?

transcript: period late by 10 days and lower tummy cramps
question_en: Are your cycles usually regular, and is there any chance of pregnancy or unusual bleeding?
question_hi: क्या माहवारी सामान्यतः नियमित है, और गर्भधारण की संभावना या असामान्य रक्तस्राव है?
question_hinglish: Periods usually regular hain, aur pregnancy possibility ya unusual bleeding hai?

transcript: period pain with faint feeling
question_en: Have you actually fainted, how heavy is the bleeding, and could you be pregnant?
question_hi: क्या आप सच में बेहोश हुईं, रक्तस्राव कितना अधिक है, और क्या गर्भधारण की संभावना है?
question_hinglish: Sach me behoshi hui, bleeding kitni heavy hai, aur pregnancy possibility hai?

transcript: baccha 2 saal ka, fever and breathing fast
question_en: Is the child pulling in at the ribs, unable to drink, unusually sleepy, or turning blue?
question_hi: क्या पसलियाँ अंदर खिंच रही हैं, बच्चा पानी नहीं पी पा रहा, बहुत सुस्त है या नीला पड़ रहा है?
question_hinglish: Ribs andar pull ho rahi hain, paani nahi pee raha, bahut sleepy ya blue ho raha?

transcript: my daughter has cough but playing normally
question_en: How long has the cough lasted, is there fever, and is she breathing comfortably during sleep?
question_hi: खाँसी कब से है, क्या बुखार है, और सोते समय सांस सामान्य चल रही है?
question_hinglish: Khansi kab se hai, fever hai, aur sote waqt breathing normal hai?

transcript: inhaler helped but wheeze came back after two hours
question_en: How many puffs have you used, and can you speak and walk normally without severe breathlessness?
question_hi: आपने कितने पफ लिए, और क्या बिना तेज़ सांस फूलने के बोल और चल पा रहे हैं?
question_hinglish: Kitne puffs liye, aur bina zyada saans phule bol/chal pa rahe hain?

transcript: seene ki jalan but not sure if heart problem
question_en: Is it brought on by exertion or relieved by rest, and do you have sweating, breathlessness, or pain spreading to the arm?
question_hi: क्या यह मेहनत से बढ़ता और आराम से घटता है, और पसीना, सांस फूलना या बांह तक दर्द है?
question_hinglish: Mehnat se badhta aur rest se kam hota hai, aur sweating, breathlessness ya arm pain hai?

transcript: back pain after fall, taking blood thinner
question_en: Did you hit your head, have new leg weakness, numbness, or difficulty controlling urine or stool?
question_hi: क्या सिर पर चोट लगी, पैर में नई कमजोरी या सुन्नपन, या पेशाब-मल पर नियंत्रण की दिक्कत है?
question_hinglish: Head hit hua, leg weakness/numbness, ya urine-stool control ki problem hai?

transcript: daant ka dard and face swelling since last night
question_en: Is the swelling spreading toward the eye or neck, or are you having trouble swallowing or breathing?
question_hi: क्या सूजन आँख या गर्दन की ओर फैल रही है, या निगलने या सांस लेने में दिक्कत है?
question_hinglish: Swelling eye ya neck ki taraf spread ho rahi, ya nigalne/saans ki dikkat hai?

transcript: ghabrahat hoti hai and heart beats fast before leaving home
question_en: How long do these episodes last, and have you ever fainted or had chest pain during one?
question_hi: ये दौरे कितनी देर चलते हैं, और क्या कभी बेहोशी या सीने में दर्द हुआ?
question_hinglish: Episodes kitni der chalte hain, aur kabhi behoshi ya chest pain hua?

transcript: pregnant 8 weeks, vomiting all day, urine very little
question_en: Can you keep fluids down, when did you last urinate, and do you feel faint or confused?
question_hi: क्या तरल रुक रहा है, आखिरी बार पेशाब कब हुआ, और चक्कर या भ्रम तो नहीं?
question_hinglish: Fluids ruk rahe hain, last urine kab hua, aur dizziness ya confusion to nahi?
